update.title: A new app version is available
update.description: You are running an old version of the app. To get the best experience, please update to the latest version.

failed_to_generate_recipe.title: Failed to generate recipe
failed_to_generate_recipe.description: We're sorry, but we were unable to generate a recipe at this time. Make sure the url you provided has the necessary information. For Instagram and TikTok, make sure the post is public and has the recipe in the caption.

shareIntent.title: Guac is currently writing your recipe!

kick.title: Are you sure?
kick.description: Are you sure you want to kick {{username}} from the group? You will have to reinvite them.

list.empty: No users found that are not in the group already

selectedList.title: No users selected yet
selectedList.description: Start by searching users and tapping on the user's avatar to select them.

createGroups.title: Create Group
createGroups.description: Create a new group to share recipes with others. Invite your friends to join the group and share recipes with them.

validation.min: Name must be at least 2 characters long

public.label: Public
public.description: People can find your group in search results and join it.

private.label: Private
private.description: Only invited members can join your group.

image.title: Create from an image
image.description: Upload or snap an image of a recipe. We will try our best to convert it to this app.
image.hint: We try to extract the recipe details from the image you provide. If the recipe is not found or the details are incomplete, you can manually edit the recipe details.

url.title: Create from URL
url.description: Enter a URL to a recipe. We will try our best to convert it to this app.

url.label: Recipe URL
url.hint: We try to extract the recipe details from the URL you provide. If the recipe is not found or the details are incomplete, you can manually edit the recipe details.

shareRecipe.title: Share recipe
shareRecipe.description: Share this recipe with your friends and family.

list.empty: You are not part of any group or you shared this recipe with all the groups you are part of.

selectedList.title: Selected groups
selectedList.description: Start by searching and tapping on the group's name to select them.

notice.title: Why this matters
notice.description: These settings will automatically hide recipes containing these ingredients and alert your shared groups to keep everyone safe.

dietaryPreferences.title: Dietary preferences
dietaryPreferences.description: These settings will automatically hide recipes containing these ingredients and alert your shared groups to keep everyone safe.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: These settings determine which notifications you receive. You can choose which notifications you want to receive.

share.title: Shared recipes
share.description: When someone shares a recipe in a group.

invites.title: Group invitations
invites.description: When you are invited to a new group.

comment.title: Comments
comment.description: When someone comments on a recipe.

recipeTranslated.title: Recipe translated
recipeTranslated.description: When your recipe completed translating to different languages.

helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.description: Need help with Flavr? Check out our help center for answers to common questions.

deleteAccount.label: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: This action will permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.

action.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account?

instagramImport.title: Importing from Instagram
instagramImport.description: Found a recipe on Instagram you want to save? You can import it in just a few steps, no manual typing required.

one.title: Find a recipe on Instagram
one.description: Scroll through the feed until you find a recipe you like.

two.title: Tap the share icon
two.description: Look for the paperplane icon in the bottom right corner of the screen.

three.title: Click on the Flavr icon
three.description: Tap the Flavr icon to import your recipe and we handle the rest.

createSheet.title: Create a new recipe
createSheet.description: There are different ways to create a recipe. The easiest way is to generate a recipe from either an image or a URL.

image.title: Generate from image
image.description: Upload or snap an image of a recipe. We will try our best to convert it to this app.

social.title: Generate from social media
social.description: Enter a URL to a recipe. We will try our best to convert it to this app.

webpage.title: Generate from web page
webpage.description: Import from a webpage using the URL.
